problems.problem_description:
# Problem setup:
Consider $\mathbb Z_N$ ($N$ is any positive integer) parafermion zero mode operators on four sites $\alpha_i$ with $i=1,2,3,4$. The operators satisfy

$$
\alpha_i^N=1,\qquad
\alpha_i^\dagger=\alpha_i^{-1},\qquad
\alpha_j\alpha_k=e^{[2\pi i{\rm sgn}(j-k)]/N}\alpha_k\alpha_j.
$$

Consider the four-stage adiabatic tunneling cycle

$$
H_{34}\rightarrow H_{23}\rightarrow H_{12}\rightarrow H_{13}\rightarrow H_{34},
$$

where

$$
H_{ij}=-t\left(e^{-i\phi_{ij}/N}\alpha_i^\dagger\alpha_j+H.c.\right),\qquad t>0.
$$

Here $\phi_{ij}$ is a phase between sites $i$ and $j$, and $H.c.$ stands for Hermitian conjugate.

Each arrow $H_A\rightarrow H_B$ denotes the adiabatic interpolation

$$
H(s)=(1-s)H_A+sH_B,\qquad 0\le s\le1.
$$

Only these two couplings are present during each interpolation, and all tunneling phases $\phi_{ij}$ are held constant throughout the cycle. Assume that the ground-state manifold remains degenerate and separated from excited states by a nonzero gap, with no additional ground-state level crossings.


# Main problem:
Determine the relative geometric phase factor $e^{i[\gamma(q)-\gamma(0)]}$ for the closed adiabatic cycle in the setup, with the dynamical phase removed. Here $\gamma(q)$ is the geometric phase acquired by the initial ground state whose unpaired pair $(\alpha_1,\alpha_2)$ has fusion channel $q$, while the coupled pair $(\alpha_3,\alpha_4)$ has ground-state channel $k_{34}$. The reference $\gamma(0)$ is evaluated for the same cycle and tunneling parameters, but with initial fusion channel $q=0$.

For each ordered pair $i<j$, adopt the fusion-channel labeling convention

$$
\alpha_i^\dagger\alpha_j|r\rangle_{ij}
=-e^{\frac{2\pi i}{N}(r-\frac12)}|r\rangle_{ij},
\qquad r\in\mathbb Z_N.
$$

Let the ground-state channels $k_{ij}\in\mathbb Z_N$ have integer representatives satisfying $k_{ij}-1<\phi_{ij}/(2\pi)+N/2<k_{ij}$.
